title: Eye of Horus, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Finest silver plated with 24-karat gold Gold-plated catch, so you can turn your coin into a stylish piece of jewelry Mystical decorations alluding to ancient Egypt Great idea for a gift Crossing the thresholds of the ancient mysterious world, the „Eye of Horus” coin becomes an amulet that not only symbolizes divine wisdom, but also brings protection on the way to learning the secrets of life. It is a mystical representation that transports us to the world of ancient Egypt, promising balance and security.
